description: Unique-MST chain of four haplotypes, one mutation apart
derivation: Hand-traced. Pairwise Hamming distances: s1-s2=1, s2-s3=1, s3-s4=1, s1-s3=2, s2-s4=2, s1-s4=3. The unique MST is the chain H1-H2-H3-H4 with unit edges (any other spanning tree has total weight > 3). Haplotype ids follow identify_haplotypes_from_alignment ordering (sorted by sequence string): AAAAA->H1, AAAAT->H2, AAATT->H3, AATTT->H4.
